description_short: Build smooth two-lane highways with T/+ intersections, roundabouts, automatic routing, and lane-following traffic.
description_long: Highway Roads adds smoothly planned, two-way highways for road vehicles. The multi-pivot construction tool supports flowing curves, repeated S-bends, tangent-continuous extensions, and exact snapping to free network ports. Dedicated tools place three-arm T intersections, four-arm + intersections, and right-hand-traffic roundabouts in all 16 planner directions. Vehicles automatically compare their normal route with reachable highway alternatives, follow the selected lanes through every node, and enter or leave at reachable segment transitions. Road-capable vehicles can reach 140% of their normal maximum speed on highway-network entities and use 50% of their base maintenance while driving on mod roads. Controls: left-click to place the start and additional pivots, double-click to build, right-click to cancel, and Shift-double-click to continue directly from the completed endpoint. The mod can be added to existing saves, but should not be removed after highway pieces have been built.
